decision.explanation: Q01 is broadly similar to C01 (excess_hall_adhesive). The Welch ranking strongly favors C01: 3.03 dB versus 7.38–10.36 dB for the other conditions, and it is much smaller than C01's 5.94 dB separation from its nearest known alternative. This is supported by the shared 5.3 Hz line, identical reported autocorrelation lag, closely matching approximately 3.5 Hz envelope cycle, persistent 16 kHz ridge, and similar 10 s time evolution. Q01 has a clear upward frequency shift of the reference's mid-frequency concentration into the approximately 939 Hz region, redistributing power toward 500–4000 Hz; nevertheless, the overall multiband shape and periodic envelope remain closest to C01. Absolute FS levels are secondary because acquisition gain is unknown, although all reports use the same duration, sample rate, physical frequency axis and 0.1 Hz FFT/43.07 Hz Welch resolutions.
